channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: Namma 112 review: How Bengaluru rebuilt its emergency response system over four years
item.description: An examination of Bengaluru's Namma 112 shows how phased technology upgrades, infrastructure changes, and new access tools reshaped the city's emergency response system between 2022 and 2025.

item.title: World Bank ranks India among top 5 in terms of private investment in infra
item.description: According to the Survey, this has been made possible by the institutionalisation of multimodal planning through PM GatiShakti, complemented by the National Logistics Policy and digital platforms that are reducing transaction costs and execution risks.

item.title: Economic Survey 2026: CEA Nageswaran flags normal rupee pressure; backs manufacturing, India's development-first AI
item.description: Ahead of Union Budget 2026, Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman tabled the Economic Survey 2025–26 in Parliament on Thursday. The Survey projects real GDP growth of 6.8–7.2 per cent and sets the tone for the Union Budget, which will be presented on February 1, 2026.

item.title: UKIBC calls for tax rationalisation, investor-friendly reforms in Budget 2026
item.description: UKIBC stressed the need for policy certainty, easier regulatory processes, and a level-playing field for international companies to fully benefit from FDI liberalisation. Business leaders have also sought targeted tax incentives, revival of the lower tax rate for manufacturing, and reforms in direct tax dispute resolution with time-bound appeal disposal.

item.title: "Stop sexualising minors": TV show Rimjhim faces backlash for intimate scene of teenager
item.description: The TV show Rimjhim—Choti Umar Bada Safar has left netizens calling for its ban after it showed a romantic scene involving the lead actress, who is a minor.

item.title: John Abraham's wrinkled face, loss of muscle, shocking weight loss leave fans concerned [Then and now photos]
item.description: Bollywood actor John Abraham, known for his fitness and muscular physique, has left the internet in shock after several pictures of his transformation surfaced online. In the new set of viral photos, the actor is seen sporting a salt-and-pepper look and a clean-shaven avatar, which has sparked concern among fans about his health.

item.title: Illegal recruiters lured Indian youth with overseas job offers; advisories, awareness drives underway
item.description: The Ministry of External Affairs has acknowledged that illegal recruitment agents have been cheating Indian youth with fake overseas job offers and illegally sending some of them to serve in the Russian Army.

item.title: Amber Hussain Siddique: Global Finance Leader Driving Strategic Transformation in Pharmaceuticals
item.description: Amber career reflects a sustained commitment to professional excellence, cross-functional collaboration, and ethical leadership

item.title: Who will succeed Ajit Pawar? Cadre wants Sunetra as Deputy CM, NCP merger also on the cards
item.description: A senior NCP minister confirmed that a lot of party leaders insisted that in order to continue Ajit Pawar's legacy, Sunetra Pawar should be made party president and Deputy Chief Minister. However, he clarified that the party, which is in deep shock from the untimely death of Ajit Pawar, is yet to take a final decision in this regard.

item.title: Studies hit by Op Sindoor, floods; J&K govt cuts syllabus by 15% for Class 10th, 11th, 12th
item.description: The J&K government has announced a 15 per cent syllabus relaxation for Class 10, 11, and 12 students of the summer zone in Jammu division after prolonged school closures caused by Operation Sindoor and unprecedented floods in August 2025.
